publication_rule: Only records with publish_ready=true should appear in the public event directory.
active_event_rule: status in [upcoming, recurring] and either end_datetime is in the future, or end_datetime is null and the local event date has not passed
expiration_rule: Events with a known end_datetime expire after that time. Events with an unknown end_datetime require review after the local event date and are then moved to ended/archive.

schema_notes.end_datetime_policy: end_datetime may be null when the organizer has not published an ending time. Such records require manual review after the event date and must not be assigned an invented ending time.
schema_notes.source_integrity_rule: Do not infer a street address, ending time, ticket link, or organizer URL that was not supported by the supplied source.

The weekend features scenic trail rides, lakeside horse swimming, camping, campfire fellowship, and plenty of time to relax with fellow horse enthusiasts.

Friday evening begins with an easy ride at 6:30 PM. Saturday riders meet at 9:00 AM and ride out at 9:30 AM before cooling off with a swim alongside their horses in Lake Texoma. Saturday evening includes a camp gathering around 6:00 PM with hamburgers and hot dogs provided for a suggested $5 contribution. Guests should bring their own drinks and a side dish or snack to share.

Sunday morning riders meet at 9:00 AM and depart at 9:30 AM for one final ride before enjoying another lakeside swim with their horses.

Participants must reserve their own campsite through Recreation.gov. The host trailer and campfire will be located at campsite A19. Complimentary coffee and muffins will be available Saturday and Sunday mornings. After reserving a campsite, participants should email their campsite number to LRRETA2018@gmail.com.

events.description: Explore the ecology, geology, flora and fauna of the Heard Sanctuary on a guided nature hike led by trained Heard guides. The posted event window is 9:30–11:30 AM; the guided hike itself lasts about 45–60 minutes. The program is included with general admission and free for Heard Museum members.
events.venue_name: Heard Natural Science Museum & Wildlife Sanctuary
events.cost_details: Included with general admission; free for Heard Museum members. Current general admission: adults $16, children ages 3–12 $12, seniors 60+ $14, and ages 2 and under free. Ticket prices may vary seasonally.
events.organizer_name: Heard Natural Science Museum & Wildlife Sanctuary
events.verification_note: Verified Aug. 29, 2026 from the official Heard Museum Sept. 5 event page, Heard Guided Trails program page and current Heard general-admission ticket page. Official event time is 9:30–11:30 AM; the guided hike is described as 45–60 minutes. Guided Trails are included with general admission and free for Heard Museum members. The Heard publishes a dedicated Sept. 5 occurrence page, so this record is treated as a one-time occurrence rather than a recurring-series page.
